result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full offline suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes.

- **`DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6517): added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery. That is the same filter the per-quarter and per-weekday purchase-order queries use.
- **`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces your example (Anna 2, Bob 1). I also gave the `purchaseOrder` helper a status overload so the test can create cancelled orders.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the sort order is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
